definitions.explanation: Washing or cleaning with water, especially referring to flush toilets or water-based cleaning systems.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}は{水洗|すいせん}トイレが{普及|ふきゅう}している。
examples.english: Flush toilets are widespread in this area.

examples.japanese: {水洗|すいせん}できる{素材|そざい}なので{手入|てい}れが{簡単|かんたん}だ。
examples.english: It's a washable material, so maintenance is easy.

examples.japanese: {古|ふる}い{家|いえ}を{水洗|すいせん}{化|か}する{工事|こうじ}をした。
examples.english: We did construction work to install flush plumbing in the old house.

notes:
{水洗|すいせん} most commonly appears in {水洗|すいせん}トイレ (flush toilet), distinguishing it from older pit-style toilets.

COMMON USES:
- {水洗|すいせん}トイレ: flush toilet
- {水洗|すいせん}{化|か}: converting to flush/water systems
- {水洗|すいせん}{式|しき}: flush type, water-wash style

NOTE: This is a homophone with {推薦|すいせん} (recommendation) and {水仙|すいせん} (narcissus/daffodil).
